answer_1.quote: Open-domain dialogue generation intends to produce coherent responses given dialogue history.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation We evaluate the diversity and the relevance of generated responses using distinct and BLEU, respectively.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation The human evaluation is conducted on 200 instances randomly sampled from the test set. We create a project on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) and employ five AMT workers to give a preference between two responses generated by our approach and a baseline.
answer_4.guideline: Workers give a preference between two responses generated by our approach and a baseline.
